name: caroline-whatsapp-sidecar
description: WhatsApp personal-account connection for Caroline (docs/MESSENGER_INTEGRATIONS_PLAN.md) -- runs as a child process of the Python backend (app/whatsapp_channel.py via app/sidecar_process.py), talking newline-delimited JSON over stdio. Uses Baileys (unofficial WhatsApp Web protocol implementation), not an official API -- there isn't one for a personal account.
